statements.status_notes: url 2.5.8 is compiled into rust-analyzer, through the ide crate and gen-lsp-types. GHSA-hrj5-67jp-wqp9 lists 2.5.9 as the fixed version. The advisory text was not available when this was assessed, so whether rust-analyzer reaches the affected code has not been established. The shipped rust-analyzer is built from the locked dependency versions of the upstream Rust 1.100.0 source tree, so a fix needs an updated lock in that tree.
